**English** | [简体中文](pull_request_template.zh-CN.md)

## Title

The PR title exactly matches its implementation issue: `type: description`. Categories are `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `docs`, `build`, `ci` and `chore`.

## Related work

The related implementation issue establishes the change context. Its closure reference is `Closes #<number>`. Local backlog entries and ADRs provide additional context.

## Problem and resulting behavior

The description explains the problem and the behavior delivered by this change.

## Implementation and trade-offs

The implementation summary records the chosen approach and consequential trade-offs.

## Verification

The evidence includes executed commands, environment, results, and relevant numerical settings. Documentation changes include link and consistency checks.

## Impact

- API impact:
- Simulated-physics impact:
- Performance impact and measurement evidence:

## Known limitations and follow-up work

The limitations and linked follow-up tasks describe remaining work.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The PR and implementation issue titles match exactly.
- [ ] The acceptance criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] Verification evidence is recorded.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the resulting behavior.
- [ ] Relevant design decisions and limitations are recorded.
- [ ] Review findings are resolved or tracked.

Review source: Maintainer self-review, external review, or identified AI-assisted checks.
